title: 🏷️ Shaped-label cache bounds
description: The bounds of the one content-keyed cache of shaped canvas labels (`canvas::text`): a label's SVG text markup (text, font size, family, fill, halo) is shaped by usvg once and its outline scene + bounds are reused by every later paint and measure of the same markup, so an unchanged frame re-parses no font face and reshapes no glyph run. The cache is least-recently-used and bounded three ways; these `const`s are the only source of the bounds (the Rust cache reads them from this document).

maximumEntries.description: Most shaped labels resident at once, per wasm module (the editor and the surface bundles each hold their own cache).

maximumBytes.description: Most resident bytes: every entry's markup key, record and outline scene (command list + path/stroke backing).

maximumEntryBytes.description: Largest single entry that is kept; a larger shaped label is painted and dropped, never evicting the working set.
